reviews.review: If you like shooting, smashing, kicking, shooting, throwing, slicing, shooting, blowing up orcs and goblins than it's perfect game for you

[h1]BURN THE HERETICS! [/h1]
This game is great fun, and that's how it can be summed up, pure joy in painting all the Emperors enemies in [i]BLOODY RED PULPS.[/i]

To start off, the story of this game is okay, it's not something that'll blow anyone away and in fact there are some elements that you can see coming from miles away. The gameplay however is the meat and bones of this game. Most guns feel great as you mow down the Orcs and Chaos with the melee being truly satisfying as you execute your enemies in brutal fashion. One of my personal favourite executions was with the Chainsword as you saw a Orc in half and slam dunk his face into the ground.    

Overall, the gameplay is fun and satisfying and you truly feel like a walking tank. My only gripe was with one enemy which [spoiler]was some Chaos Wizard whatever that[/spoiler] would lock onto you with a laser beam and kill you in 3 seconds flat if you don't shoot him in time or find cover.
Multiplayer is dead, brothers. The story is sheer violent, satisfying, sweet bolter/melee porn

I honestly have a hard time thinking about the things I can really praise this game for.

I can say that the sound, music, voice acting were alright.

The setting is somewhat monotonous in terms of color, but the sense of scale makes it feel powerful.

The graphics are alright for a game of its age, yet there are some weak points.

The story is .... rather cliche and somewhat uninspiring. It is extremely similar to the story of Dawn of War: Warhammer 40k. I know they have the same developer, but still. It is not bad, nor entirely the same as in the other game, yet I cant really give the game a plus for creative laziness.

Now the main aspect of the game why people would be interested in it. The gameplay. I can without a doubt say that this game has been build entirely with consoles in mind and that the PC version was an afterthought. Your movements in the game are very sluggish. Dodging, fighting, running isnt comfortable at all.
There are a lot of weapons, the combat is pretty intense, you get constant perks throughout the game up until the final chapters. There is also a collectible with audio stories, which is nice. But for someone who never really got used to "console movement" it does not make up for the awkwardness I felt during the game. It wasnt as bad as it could be, but still.

Your enjoyment of the game will vary depending on how much you are capable of navigating throughout this issue.

Still, its a nice game and I can see people finding it enjoyable.

6/10
